NECK AND BACK. [31] [Graph.]
Pain in nape of neck.
Stiffness of back of neck ; also with headache.
Glands on side of neck down to shoulder, swollen and painful when bending neck to one side, or lying upon it ; as if tense and stiff.
Glandular swellings on left side of neck.
Painless swollen glands on side of neck.
Small boils on neck, back and arms.
Eruption on nape of neck dry, peeling in fine, mealy scales, without itching.
Chronic eruption on scalp and nape of neck ; falling out of hair ; dandruff ; terrible itching and burning ; skin on nape of neck hard, nodulous and rough ; habitual constipation ; in a woman past climacteric age.
Small of back aches, as if bruised or broken.
Pain in small of back, as if broken, especially on touching ; pressing, grasping and twitching, with sensation in arms and feet as if they were turned outward.
Tabes dorsalis, especially in women, with great weakness in legs and back, palpitation ; dulness of sense ; numbness or torpor of genital organs and pains in chest.
Contracting pains in back.
Weakness in back and loins on walking ; back aches.
Sacral pains, with sensation of crawling and stitching.
Numb pain, from sacrum down legs.
Dull drawing in coccyx in evening.
Pain in os coccygis while urinating.
Violent itching of coccygeal region, the part becoming moist with scurfy formations.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Graph.]
Shoulder and neck painful.
Tearing in left shoulder-joint, on moving arm.
Rheumatic or burning pains, especially in left shoulder.
Violent sticking in left shoulder.
Burning pressure beneath armpit.
Right upper arm sore, tender and swollen.
Arms feel "asleep".
Jerking in arms.
Herpes circinatus hard to touch and wrinkled looking, itching terribly, in bend of elbow.
Cramp in hand.
Tearing in hands like rheumatism.
Left hand numb and dead, with formication extending up arm.
Horny callosities in hands.
Skin of hands hard and cracked.
Eczema upon back of left hand ; commencing in a small place with vesicles ; spreads, forms crusts, and finally fissures, especially upon knuckles of first phalanges.
Gouty swellings of fingers ; in joints.
Raw, moist places between fingers.
Constant chafed soreness between fingers.
Pain in thumb-joint, as if sprained.
Rheumatic pressive tearing in first joint of right thumb.
Vesicle on little finger itches, suppurates and discharges much matter, with burning and sticking, which, like the suppuration, continues a long time.
Finger-nails black and rough, matrix inflamed, with soreness, throbbing and numbness, no suppuration ; < from water.
Finger-nails become thick.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Graph.]
Smarting soreness between nates.
Eruption over nates and posterior part of thighs ; no diffused redness, but numerous small, brown scabs, with slight moisture ; occasional paroxysms of itching ; troublesome at night ; some small, red, itching spots on arms.
Painful soreness between pudendum and thigh, covered with pimples, vesicles and ulcers.
Red, raw spot like a tetter on upper part of thigh, opposite scrotum, itching somewhat in morning.
Painful soreness between upper part of thighs near genitals.
Pains extending from pudenda to thighs.
Soreness high up between thighs, during and after walking.
Tearing or bruised pains in thighs.
Numbness of thighs.
Ulcers on lower limbs, with acrid pus, dryness of skin and constipation.
Restlessness in legs.
Heaviness of legs.
Legs and feet heavy and swollen ; she thought her feet must burst.
Swelling of legs, even while lying in bed.
Great œdema of limbs, chiefly lower, which are very large, with profuse, constant, watery exudation from skin below knees, epidermis exfoliated. θ Ascites.
Bruised pain in knees.
Stiff feeling in hollow of knee, as if tendons were too short.
Tetters in hollow of knee.
Jerking in all the muscles of left calf.
Cramp in calves.
Weakness of feet, cannot walk.
Sometimes feet are icy-cold, again quite burning.
Cold feet in evening in bed.
Coldness of dorsum of foot.
Feet sweat profusely (not so offensive as under Silica), but moderate walking causes soreness between toes, so that the parts become raw.
Profuse sweat on feet ; they begin to smell.
Ulcers on feet, form purulent pustules, always inflamed and very painful.
Callous ulcers of the feet.
Œdema pedum, with solitary itching papula ; erysipelatous redness of face ; menses scanty.
Œdema pedum from amenorrhœa.
Rheumatic tearing in feet and toes.
Burning of heels with crawling, especially in morning in bed.
Stitches in heel, when putting it down.
Gouty tearing in toes.
Stiffness and contraction of toes.
Ulcers, or spreading blisters on toes.
Horny skin on toes.
Sore pains of corns. θ Lung disease.
Thick and crippled toe-nails.
Hypertrophied nail of left big toe ; it was formed almost like a horn, and so hard, that only by repeated and long-continued operations with a file, it could be diminished.
Pain in nail of great toe.
Ingrowing toe-nail.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Graph.]
Drawing pains in limbs.
Tearing pain in feet and hands ; in all the limbs.
Falling asleep of arms and legs while sitting ; while walking, crawling in them.
Limbs go "to sleep".
Weakness of all the limbs.
Startings of hands and feet.
Heaviness in limbs.
Paralyzed sensation of all the limbs.
Hands and feet either hot or cold.
Limbs drawn together, crooked, from bones being bent.
Back of both forearms and dorsum of hand covered with corroding, herpetic exanthema, consisting partly of a kind of cortical crusts, partly of red fissures, looking like raw meat, partly of elevated islets ; the exanthema was spreading and painfully itching, especially at night ; discharge of turbid matter and acrid water ; lips and skin of fingers fissured ; upper arm nearly free ; on lower extremities flexors are affected, and especially bend of knee and external surface, with same discharge and same burning itching, which becomes < when eruption is dry ; < during fall ; > during summer ; pale, slightly œdematous face ; sluggishness of all secretions and excretions ; spontaneous fissures in skin ; cannot bear damp atmosphere ; when a youth had measles, and in consequence of bathing too soon had paralysis of face ; mouth drawn sideways ; cannot close left eye, which looks smaller than right.
Eczema chronic on dorsal region of both forearms and hands, and on bends of knees and calves of legs ; eruption composed partly of thick crusts and partly of a raw surface, with deep rhagades, constantly secreting eczematous fluid ; intolerable itching, < at night and from warmth of bed ; lips chapped, fingers full of rhagades ; face pale, bloated ; bowels torpid, constipated ; all < in damp and wet.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Graph.]
Obliged to lie down : vertigo headache.
Pains in back compel her to stay in bed.
Inclination to sit down.
Lying in bed : swelling of legs, soreness from.
Lying down : > crampy, spasmodic, clawing pain in stomach ; on left hypochondrium, pain < ; anxiety and oppression of chest.
Lying on neck : causes pain.
Lying : on right side, pain in belly, in left ; lying upon left pain in right side. θ Between catamenial periods.
While sitting : falling asleep of arms and legs.
Sitting down : pain in hemorrhoids ; profuse leucorrhœa ; weakness of back.
Stooping : during and after, vertigo ; everything turns black before eyes ; saliva runs from mouth.
Standing : < pain with heaviness of abdomen.
Looking upward : vertigo.
Putting down heel : causes stitches.
Bending neck : causes pain.
Stiffness on first beginning to move.
Motion : causes pain in thoracic muscles.
Motion during eating, talking, laughing or yawning : brings on attacks of convulsions of left side of body.
Every motion : < strong pulsation of blood ; causes sweat.
Least exertion : stitches in chest and palpitation of heart.
Rising : from bed feels as if drunken ; < crampy pain in stomach ; weight in abdomen.
Moving jaw : cracking in ear.
Walking : eructations ; profuse leucorrhœa ; weakness in back and loins ; soreness high up between thighs during and after ; causes soreness between toes.
Every step makes reverberations in ear.
Reaching high with arms : pain in uterus.
Child throws itself back and straightens body.
